key.name: display-duration
key.summary: How long the strip stays up, in milliseconds
key.description: Time the strip stays fully visible after the slide finishes, before it fades out. Each new switch restarts it.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: How long the strip takes to slide to the new workspace while its name grows into the centre. 0 jumps straight there.

key.name: bottom-offset
key.summary: Distance from the bottom edge, in percent
key.description: Gap between the bottom of the monitor and the bottom of the strip, as a percentage of the monitor's height.

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Font size of the current workspace name, in pixels
key.description: Neighbouring names are drawn at 0.6 of this size.

key.name: strip-width-em
key.summary: Strip width, in multiples of the font size
key.description: The pill is this many times the current font size wide (7.5 × 24 px = 180 px). Names beyond it fade out at the edges.

key.name: show-dots
key.description: A row of dots under the name shows which workspace is current out of how many.

key.name: unnamed-format
key.description: Shown for workspaces without a name. {number} is replaced with the workspace's number, counting from 1. Left blank, the number alone is shown.
